text:
I want a fierce love of claw and tooth

That assaults me treacherously in broad daylight,

And that suffocates this pride of mine,

This pride of being all-powerful.


I want a fierce love of claw and tooth

That in raw flesh begins my bleeding,

To see if this melancholy ends

That slowly corrupts my soul.


I want a love that is a storm,

That breaks everything and stirs everything

Because deep vigor feeds it.


So that there my clay may revive,

my poor clay of a tired animal,

Sick of rolling along old paths.

translation.title: I Want a Fierce Love of Claw and Tooth...
translation.editorial_note: This related version preserves the source's capitalized line openings while matching the translated imagery.
